items.q: How were 178 major sites fed malware?
items.a: A signup bug let attackers write JavaScript into other customers' **Optimizely projects**, served from **Optimizely's own CDN**.

items.q: How much did the attackers reportedly make?
What caused the Java Base64 RCE?
items.a: An **AVX-512 fast-path decoder** writes **62 bytes past the buffer** on short, badly padded input.
Refunded HTTP/2 credit skipped the **2 GB cap check**, so an **unsigned counter underflowed** into memory corruption.

items.q: Why are many sites probably safe from the NGINX exploit?
items.a: It needs **128 GB over one connection**, which usually fails **behind a proxy**.
